* fix: iOS 26 performance and polish by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/610
* Fix reasoning effort persistence for unsupported models by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/613
* Fix note editor context-menu crashes by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/614
* fix(auth): finish proxy login after iOS redirects by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/615


**Full Changelog**: https://github.

## What's Changed
* Enable optimized R8 resource shrinking with AGP 9 by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/607

## Conduit 4.0 is here

Hi! This is the biggest update since Conduit began, and I'm really excited to share it. Your chats now live on your phone first, and you can use Conduit entirely without a server. ### Local persistence Chats, notes, and drafts are kept safely on your device. Notes and drafts remain available without a connection; co

## What's Changed
* fix: render slashes in assistant messages instead of / (#549) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/561
* fix: request iOS microphone permission in voice preflight (#557) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/562
* Polish phase-aware chat streaming and markdown rendering by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/537
* Warn instead of blocking newer Open WebUI servers by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/c

## What's Changed
* Bump max supported Open WebUI version to 0.10.2 by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/547

## What's Changed

- Added compatibility for Open WebUI 0.10, including updated chat streaming, structured output, knowledge upload, tool-call, settings, and conversation parsing behavior.
- Added a clear compatibility gate for unsupported newer Open WebUI servers, so Conduit now blocks known-incompatible server versions with guidance instead of failing unpredictably.
- Fixed assistant response rendering that could rapidly flash between streamed content and the loading skeleton during genera

## What's Changed

- Conduit is much better offline. Chats, folders, notes, search, uploads, and pending messages stay available locally, with changes queued until your Open WebUI server is reachable again. 
- Voice mode is more hands-free and natural, with native iOS/Android speech, continuous listening, and barge-in so you can interrupt playback by speaking. 
- Notifications are now built in for finished responses, channel messages, and DMs. 
- Streaming, notes, and conversation loading a

- Fix Android permissions.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v3.2.0...v3.2.1

- Fix socket connection issues.
- Fix images leaking into responses.
- Implement model pinning.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v3.1.5...v3.1.6

- Fix flashing response placeholders appearing during streaming.
- Fix SSO auth and replace webview package.
- Remove haptics for sidebar open and close.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v3.1.4...v3.1.5

- Fix scroll jumps and chats not scrolling to bottom on open.
- Fix empty assistant response on stopping generation.
- Standardize pull to refresh indicator placement.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v3.1.3...v3.1.4

- Added location-aware prompt support for `USER_LOCATION`.
- Added mobile location permissions and `geolocator`.
- Fixed web search visibility using server, user, and model feature flags.
- Cleaned up iOS metadata and lockfile formatting.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v3.1.2...v3.1.3

- Refined chat scrolling, keyboard anchoring, and pin-to-top behavior.
- Fixed iOS voice input audio routing and speech recognizer recovery.
- Fixed self-signed/mTLS image loading and Android home widget dependency resolution.
- Improved terminal tab lifecycle handling and sidebar layout polish.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v3.1.0...v3.1.1

- Refined chat toolbar and conversation actions with adaptive sizing, overflow menus, and cleaner temporary-chat controls.
- Added native iOS sheet support for text editing and expanded native selector/detail sheet interactions.

apps.subtitle: Native mobile client for OpenWebUI.
apps.localizedDescription: Native mobile client for OpenWebUI. Chat with your self-hosted AI.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Conduit uses the camera to take photos or videos you choose to share in chats.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Conduit uses the microphone to record voice messages and enable voice-to-text in chats.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Conduit needs access to your photo library so you can select existing images or videos to share in chats.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Conduit uses on-device speech recognition so you can dictate messages hands-free.
